description: Projects watched by the HQ Watchdog. Each entry is one project the watchdog ingests commits, sessions, and (optionally) lessons for. claude-hq is the default project — used as fallback when no project is specified, but holds no special status in the code.

projects.name: claude-hq
projects.notes: Primary HQ orchestration brain. Watched since the watchdog was first built.

projects.name: POLYMARKET_TRADING_3.0
projects.notes: Polymarket trading bot. name MUST match the directory basename so session-file ingestion (which uses basename) finds rows. display_name is the friendly label used in alerts. lessons_path null per Decision Log Option A — repeated_mistake_signal scoped to claude-hq lessons only for v1.

projects.name: ai-agent-fleet-ventures
projects.notes: Autonomous agent portfolio with Darwinian mortality. Mission Control fork at dashboard/mission-control-fleet/ tracked separately as subrepo (its own git remote, not part of this project's commits). Paperclip control plane evaluated 2026-04-27 — pivot decision pending. lessons_path points to project-local LESSONS_FLEET.md (separate from HQ-wide commander/LESSONS.md per brief).

projects.name: get-rich-scheme
projects.notes: Reddit pain-point to micro-SaaS pipeline (Tiiny.host model). 6-phase operator-gated pipeline. Phase 0 ready to trigger 2026-05-09. No git repo yet (deferred until Phase 4 build). Layers 0+A+B; not C/D. Phase 5 is draft-and-deliver, never auto-post. Self-sustaining cron loops deferred until first validated launch.

projects.name: insta-notion-sync
projects.notes: IG saved-videos to Notion auto-sync. Android share intent → Notion DB → Mac LaunchAgent (every 15 min) → yt-dlp + Gemini 2.5 Flash → enriched Notion entry. Forward-only (no backfill). Free tier (Gemini AI Studio, no card). Plan B fallback: local Whisper + Claude Haiku. Layers 0+A+B; not C/D. lessons_path null — project-local lessons in vault, HQ-wide stay in commander/LESSONS.md.

projects.name: flightclub-legal-tax-advisor
projects.notes: Internal cited decision-support tax-advisory tool for flightclub.33 zero-tax-structuring arm. name matches dir basename for session-file ingestion. Pre-build as of 2026-05-30: research complete, PRD next. Living knowledge base — continuously evolved as laws change. Layers 0+A(light)+B; not C/D (decision-support, not autonomous capital agent).

projects.name: OFFLIMITS
projects.notes: Content agency (renamed from OFFSCRIPT). git repo content-creation-agency; canonical copy MOVED to the external drive 2026-06-03, so repo_path is only readable when /Volumes/Elements is mounted (watchdog skips it when the drive is unmounted). Worked mainly via Cowork, so Claude Code session-file ingestion may not capture sessions; commit-watching works when mounted. Hybrid asset policy (raw image pools drive-only). Layers 0+A+B.

projects.name: bidfill
projects.notes: Product (sig-D-01) built out of the get-rich-scheme pipeline. Auto-fills public-agency bid PDFs from a saved contractor profile. Own repo SUNMANOFFICIAL189/bidfill (private). Web = Next.js on Cloudflare Pages; data = Supabase+RLS; fill engine = Python worker on Hetzner CX23 (77.42.43.44); LLM = paid-tier Gemini. Two spikes green (detection + placement). Phase 4 build started 2026-07-05 on Opus 4.8 + phased orchestration. Layers 0+A+B (A=worker resilience; not C/D, single product). Spec + spikes live in ../get-rich-scheme.

projects.name: whitelabel-banking-research
projects.notes: Supplier-decision research: white-label banking + physical card issuing. Triggered by a $10k API-integration quote from kalzero.com. Verdict delivered 2026-07-28 (don't proceed with Kalzero as-is; 25-provider alternative survey). Layer 0 ONLY — research project, no long-running process, no autonomous decisions, so no A/B/C/D layers apply. Local git, NO remote (deliberate — see project Decision Log 2026-08-10). PARKED awaiting operator input (region, fiat-vs-crypto, volume), not further research. Expect low commit activity; that is the parked state, not a stall.
